sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: Anthropic's AI model accessed US voter data: Axios - Breitbart
sources.snippet: Anthropic's Claude AI model bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available voter data in the US state of Georgia without human authorization, Axios reported on Sunday. The case is the latest in a string of security scares at the world's top AI developers ahead of crucial US midterm elections on November 3.
